params.headline: Where the ingredients in your products come from.
params.subhead: Decades of supplier relationships, ingredient sourcing networks, and supplier vetting procedures. The quality of your finished product traces back to where the ingredient was grown, extracted, or synthesized.

params.content:
Most supplement brands can't tell you where their ingredients come from. We can.

Ingredient sourcing is where supplement quality is built or broken. We have decades of supplier relationships, country-of-origin documentation, and vetting procedures for every raw material in our catalog.

When customers ask your brand 'where does this come from,' you can provide answers with documentation behind them. That level of transparency is increasingly rare in the supplement market and increasingly valuable for brand trust.

cards.content: Many of our ingredient suppliers have been with us for 10, 20, or 30+ years. Long-term relationships drive consistent quality and supply chain reliability.
cards.title: Decades of supplier relationships

cards.content: We document where each ingredient is sourced and can provide that information for your brand's marketing and customer communication.
cards.title: Country-of-origin transparency

cards.content: Direct relationships with branded ingredient producers (Tonalin, Cognizin, Bioenergy Ribose, Curcumin C3 Complex, etc.) give you access to ingredients that have clinical research behind them.
cards.title: Branded ingredient access

params.content: Schedule a consultation. We will walk through your audience, the right formulations for them, branding options, and the timeline.
params.headline: Ready to launch your private label supplement line?

items.answer: Different ingredients come from different places depending on where the highest-quality source exists. Botanical ingredients often come from India, China, or specific U.S. regions depending on the plant. Vitamins and minerals come from major suppliers in the U.S., Europe, and Japan. We disclose country of origin on request for every ingredient.
items.question: Where do your ingredients come from?

items.answer: Yes. We have supplier relationships with most major branded ingredient companies. Branded ingredients add cost but give you marketing leverage (the brand story, the published research, the certifications). We help you decide where branded ingredients are worth the premium.
items.question: Do you use branded ingredients (Curcumin C3, NKO, Sensoril, etc.)?

items.answer: Three layers: supplier qualification (audits, documentation, history), incoming raw material testing (identity, potency, contaminants on every lot), and process verification during manufacturing. We don't release any finished product unless every ingredient passes our incoming tests.
items.question: How do you verify ingredient quality from suppliers?

items.answer: For private label, you use the sources we've qualified for each formulation. For custom formulation, you can specify branded ingredients or alternative sources, subject to our qualification and stability testing. We give you transparency on what's available and what tradeoffs are involved.
items.question: Can I specify or change ingredient sources?

items.answer: Many are. For botanicals specifically, we look at sustainability and ethical sourcing practices as part of supplier qualification. For some ingredients we have specific sustainable or fair-trade certified sources available at slight premiums. We can guide you toward sustainability-positioned options where they exist.
